QUOTE: "Compile-time macros. Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... The runtime setter is not compiled in at all in this mode, so calling it fails to link." and "(no runtime pointers, and platform.c:20-64 is compiled out)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It says the macros compile out the runtime pointers and setter, so the two are mutually exclusive.
